run_ccnews_stats: run the CC-NEWS statistics tool to count samples, URLs, sentences, and words in gzip JSON files
process_json_line: process a single JSON line from CC-NEWS to extract URL, sentence count, and word count
process_cc_news_files: process multiple CC-NEWS gzip files in parallel using multiprocessing to compute aggregate statistics
get_lines: read and yield lines from a list of gzip compressed JSON files with optional debug mode
get_parser: create an argparse parser with doc_dir, workers, and debug arguments for CC-NEWS stats
